narrative.overview: Descriptive current-state record only — no creative direction is asserted. See DESIGN.md Overview.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant brand color (#000d6e) carrying both text and action roles
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow tokens defined but not visibly deployed
Four-color pastel family reserved for stat/number tiles only
Ad-hoc type scale (38px / 24px / 16px), not a single modular ratio

rules.name: The One-Navy Rule
rules.body: The site does not separate text-gray from brand-blue — #000d6e is both. Introducing a distinct neutral-text-gray is a deliberate departure from the current system.

rules.name: The No-System-Fallback Rule
rules.body: Computed font-family reports no fallback stack after BaloiseBold/BaloiseText — font-load failure is an open, uncaptured risk.

dos: Do keep #000d6e as both the default text color and the primary action color
Do reserve the four pastel accent tones for stat/number tiles, matching current usage
Do treat French as a genuine layout stress test — personnes-privees copy runs measurably longer than German
donts: Don't introduce a separate neutral-gray body-text color as a cleanup
Don't assume shadow tokens are load-bearing; none render visibly on the crawled pages
Don't invent pricing, coverage terms, or customer/rating numbers not already present in the captured copy
